title: WT Utility OP Script Updated June 2026
features:
Automatic chapter detection — instantly identifies whether you're in Chapter 1, 2, 3, or 4

Auto Collect Chest — teleports to every detected chest and loots them automatically

Auto Collect Resources — scans all L6Res_ objects and teleports to each one sequentially

Fast Teleports — instant access to all major areas with one click

Daily Reward TP — automatically teleports you to the daily reward location

Conversion Teleports — quick TP to Eons, Generations, Mercury, Archives, and more

Auto ProximityPrompt — automatically triggers benches, upgrades, stats, and all prompts

Auto Click — intelligent spam for ClickDetectors (Cube, Buttons, etc.)

Auto Upgrades — auto‑upgrade Archives, Scraps, and hidden systems

Advanced toggle system — every feature can be enabled/disabled independently

Complete TP Data — precise coordinates for every chapter already included

Optimized code — no useless loops, cooldown management, anti‑crash logic

Compatible with executors — works with Real, Velocity, and probably most other good executors
